Buying a dev card is a good way to stay under the radar while Claude and Gemma argue, and a Knight could help protect my Ore/Brick production or get me closer to the Largest Army. Since I can't build or upgrade right now, and Gemma won't trade her Ore, buying a development card is the most productive move.
